synopsis: SET Level published the Credible Simulation Process in August 2021; related work includes prostep ivip’s Simulation Credibility technical paper, version 8.1, dated 2024 [f14592, f14593]. The method embeds credibility activities throughout product development, including task definition, evidence planning, assumption recording, verification and validation, and credibility information accompanying models [f7697, f14594]. Credibility levels scale with the criticality of the simulation task, and the process is cited in a 2025 Sensors paper on continuous verification and validation of active-perception sensor simulations [f15703, f8949]. Alongside M&S SPICE, it addresses validation against physical data and transfer through credibility documentation, but does not specify what physical evidence remains necessary [f8126, f8127, f8128]. For off-road automatic braking, the booklet therefore treats it as a process template, not a proven method [f8129, f8130, f15704].
